stepExplanation: Increasing the concentration of HCl means there are more HCl particles per unit volume. This results in more frequent collisions between Zn and H$$^+$$ ions, so the reaction rate increases.
stepBody: If the concentration of HCl is increased (for example, from 1 mol/dm$$^3$$ to 2 mol/dm$$^3$$), how does this affect the reaction rate?
